title: Himanshi Khurana Sparks Dating Buzz With Romantic Video, Netizen Asks 'Who Is This Man?' | Television News - News18
text:
Himanshi Khurana has left everyone wondering if she has found love again. Recently, the Punjabi singer-actress took to her Instagram handle and dropped a romantic video in which he was seen travelling in a car. She held a flower in her hand as she shied away from the camera and flaunted her smile. Himanshi also added the song ‘Tum Ho Toh’ from the film Saiyaara in the backdrop of her video. However, soon after the video was shared online, netizens noticed the shadow of a man, who was recording Himanshi’s video, in the window. This left everyone wondering if the actress is dating somebody now. “Who is this man 😍?" one of the users asked. “Car ki side mein boy," added another. Check it out here:
Recommended Stories View this post on Instagram
A post shared by Himanshi Khurana 👑 (@iamhimanshikhurana)
Who Was Himanshi Khurana Dating Previously? Himanshi Khurana was previously dating Asim Riaz. The two met in the Bigg Boss 13 house. They fell in love with each other and were together for four years before announcing their breakup in December 2023.
Later in June 2024, a report by Hindustan Times claimed that the two parted ways over religious beliefs. An insider cited by the portal claimed that Himanshi is “sensitive" about her “ugly" breakup and therefore, avoids talking about it.
Following this, Himanshi also issued a statement and urged everyone to respect her privacy. “My biggest flex is that nobody ever knows what’s really going on in my life. Where I am, or my next move, unless I make it known. Therefore, anything anyone says is just an assumption. Privacy is my luxury. Privacy is my peace. Better do not try to be my close source," she wrote.
Has Asim Riaz Also Found Love Again? After his breakup with Himanshi, Asim is also rumoured to be dating somebody else. Previously, the Bigg Boss 13 fame took to his Instagram stories and dropped a picture of a mystery woman. In the photo, the woman was seen posing with her back towards the camera. However, Asim has not issued any official statement confirming or denying his new relationship.
